story_title: Microsoft Windows Print Spooler RCE CVE-2021-34527 (PrintNightmare) actively exploited

A propose with keyword-matching rows and an insufficient_evidence with preserved unknowns are both contract-legal outcomes; confidence routing consistency, receipts, Story immutability, and idempotency are asserted in all cases. Disjoint from both development datasets and the consumed first holdout.
